description: In 2024, Dimas made history as the first Democrat in 16 years to advance from the primary in the district, coming historically close to flipping the seat in the general election. Now, she is launching her campaign with renewed determination, focused on bringing this win home pa’ la gente.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Chelsea Dimas for State Rep Pa’ la gente
title: Chelsea Dimas Announces 2026 Campaign for State Representative in the 14th Legislative District — Chelsea Dimas for State Rep (D)
